description: This PHP source file generates a web page for managing LAN Ethernet settings on a gateway device. It includes server-side logic to retrieve device parameters, and client-side JavaScript for user interactions such as enabling/disabling port features and updating settings via AJAX. The page displays Ethernet port statuses, connection speeds, and allows configuration of port 2 as part of a home security network.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 is enabled for XFINITY Home Security based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps device status strings to user-friendly labels for display.
